regions.explanation: From 20.48s to 23.07s (“loss. Nineteen years ago, almost to the day, we”), 2 pause(s) at punctuation shrank from 530 ms to 20 ms on average. Fix: Hold a clear pause at each punctuation mark, about as long as the reference.
